text.hi: संज्ञा की जगह आने वाले शब्द सर्वनाम हैं: he, she, it, they, I, you, we, them। Reena → she, Mother and father → they।
text.hinglish: Sangya ki jagah aane waale shabd sarvanaam hain: he, she, it, they, I, you, we, them. Reena → she, Mother and father → they.
text.en: Words that replace nouns are pronouns: he, she, it, they, I, you, we, them. Reena → she, Mother and father → they.

steps.sentence: Leena always enjoyed it because ___ was allowed to spend most of the day at the mango grove.

meaning.hi: लीना को मज़ा आता था क्योंकि उसे दिन भर आम के बाग़ में रहने दिया जाता था।
meaning.hinglish: Leena ko maza aata tha kyonki use din bhar aam ke baag mein rehne diya jaata tha.

steps.sentence: Her uncle was a friend of the man who owned the grove and ___ always gave mangoes at a special rate.

meaning.hi: उसके चाचा बाग़ के मालिक के दोस्त थे और वह हमेशा ख़ास दाम पर आम देता था।
meaning.hinglish: Uske chaacha baag ke maalik ke dost the aur woh hamesha khaas daam par aam deta tha.

meaning.hi: इस साल उसकी चाची भी उसके साथ आईं।
meaning.hinglish: Is saal uski chaachi bhi uske saath aayin.

steps.sentence: This year her aunt joined ___, and together they set off.

meaning.hi: इस साल उसकी चाची उसके साथ आईं और दोनों चल पड़ीं।
meaning.hinglish: Is saal uski chaachi uske saath aayin aur dono chal padin.

steps.sentence: The branches were so bowed down with the weight that ___ almost touched the ground.

meaning.hi: डालियाँ बोझ से इतनी झुकी थीं कि लगभग ज़मीन छू रही थीं।
meaning.hinglish: Daaliyaan bojh se itni jhuki thin ki lagbhag zameen chhoo rahi thin.

steps.sentence: They spent hours picking the fruit, eating most of ___.

meaning.hi: उन्होंने घंटों फल तोड़े और ज़्यादातर खा गईं।
meaning.hinglish: Unhone ghanton phal tode aur zyaadatar kha gayin.
